snippet.title: Rubber Bird Announcement Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Jump, stretch your arms, grab, and throw everything around you in Rubber Bird! Follow Rub on his quest to answer the big question: why does he have arms? This lighthearted physics platformer is designed to be welcoming and goofy. https://wholesomegames.com/ #WholesomeDirect2026
